lines.japanese: 放課後のアレキサンダーは、空きすぎず混みすぎず、ちょうどいい客の入り具合だった。
lines.english: Alexander after school was neither too empty nor too crowded. Just the right number of customers.

lines.japanese: 軽部店長の話を聞くに、今日は玉泉日和子や日野英里子もシフトに入ってるらしい。
lines.english: According to Manager Karube, both Hiyoko Tamaizumi and Eriko Hino were working today.

lines.japanese: 望月紀奈子は今でもよく客として来てるって言うし、運がよければ鳳翔にも会えるかもしれない。
lines.english: Kinako Mochizuki still came in often as a customer, and if I was lucky, I might even see Kakeru Ohtori.

lines.japanese: 俺の当面の目標は、視野を広げることだ。
lines.english: For the time being, my goal was to broaden my perspective.

lines.japanese: 彼らのように個性豊かな面々とは、積極的に関わっていきたい。
lines.english: I wanted to engage actively with colorful characters like them.

lines.japanese: 身の周りの親しいひとびとを、普段とは違う角度から見てみたい。
lines.english: I wanted to look at the people close to me from angles I normally overlooked.

lines.japanese: それによって、彼らの新しい一面を引きだしてみよう。
lines.english: Perhaps that would draw out sides of them I had never seen.

lines.japanese: ま、実際そこまで大袈裟ではないが、まずは機会を用意してくれた軽部店長に感謝するとしよう。
lines.english: Well, it wasn't really anything so grand. But first, I would thank Manager Karube for giving me the opportunity.

lines.japanese: 俺は二階への階段を、一足飛びでのぼっていった。
lines.english: I bounded up the stairs two steps at a time.

lines.japanese: 「急に声をかけてすまなかったな。今日は他にも欠員が出て困っていたところだったんだ」
lines.english: “Sorry to call you in so suddenly. We had another absence today and were in a bind.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、何をおっしゃりますやら。困っているひとがいれば助けたい。当然のことじゃないですか」
lines.english: “Nonsense. When someone is in trouble, I want to help. Isn't that only natural?”

lines.japanese: 「う、ううむ……どうしたことだ、今日の鷲介はいつもより輝いて見えるぞ。しばらく見ないうちに何かが変わったと言うのか」
lines.english: “H-hmm... What has happened to you? Shuusuke, you seem to shine brighter than before. Has something changed in the short time since last we met?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、男子三日会わざればというじゃありませんか。外見上は変わらないかもしれませんが、男を輝かせるのはいつも中身。いまの俺は、自分磨きへのステップアップを着実に踏みしめているところなんです」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. As the saying goes, three days apart can make a man worth seeing in a new light. My appearance may be unchanged, but what makes a man shine is always within. Right now, I'm steadily climbing the ladder of self-improvement.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんと頼もしいやつだ。ならば鷲介、いまから女性客のテーブルを下から覗いた気になってげへげへする遊びをしようぜ」
lines.english: “W-what a dependable fellow! In that case, Shuusuke, let us play a game where we imagine peering up at the female customers from beneath their tables and snicker lecherously.”

lines.japanese: 「いいでしょう、ただし一従業員に負けたとあっては、軽部店長の地位が危うい……それを承知で勝負を挑んでいるのでしょうな？」
lines.english: “Very well. But if a mere employee defeats you, Manager Karube's position will be in jeopardy... You issue this challenge with that understanding, I presume?”

lines.japanese: 「ふん、どんなに油断しようと、この俺が鷲介に後れをとるかよ。さあ行くぞ、格の違いってやつを見せつけてやる！」
lines.english: “Hmph. No matter how completely I lower my guard, I could never fall behind you. Come! I shall demonstrate the gulf between our ranks!”

lines.japanese: 「よし、それなら先手必勝だ！　おりゃあああ！」
lines.english: “Then first strike wins! Hyaaaa!”

lines.japanese: 俺は軽部店長のおふざけに乗って勢いよく事務所の外へ飛びだしたのだが――
lines.english: I eagerly played along with Manager Karube's foolishness and burst out of the office—

lines.japanese: ――飛びでたところで、鬼教官に出くわしてしまった。
lines.english: —only to run straight into my demon instructor.

lines.japanese: 「げっ、玉泉日和子！」
lines.english: “Gah! Hiyoko Tamaizumi!”

lines.japanese: ひいい、俺のお茶目が最高潮を迎えたところで……あわわわわ。
lines.english: Eeeek! Just when my playfulness had reached its zenith... Wh-wh-what now?

lines.japanese: 「あの」
lines.english: “Excuse me.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes, ma'am.”

lines.japanese: たった一声飛んできただけで、鷲介時代の悲しき習性か、俺は背筋をぴんと伸ばし、中指をズボンの線にぴっちり合わせていた。
lines.english: One word from her and some tragic habit from my Shuusuke days snapped my spine straight and planted my middle fingers precisely along the seams of my pants.

lines.japanese: ひいいいいっ、雷が来る！　怒られる――！
lines.english: Eeeeeek! Here came the thunder! She was going to yell at me—!

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん……」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose...”

lines.japanese: 「はいっ」
lines.english: “Yes, ma'am!”

lines.japanese: 「店内ではお客様の迷惑にならないようお願いしますね」
lines.english: “Please be careful not to disturb the customers in the dining room.”

lines.japanese: 「ひいっ、ごめんなさ――」
lines.english: “Eek! I'm so sor—”

lines.japanese: ――あれ？
lines.english: —Wait.

lines.japanese: 雷、落ちない？　どころか……えっ？　あれ？　え、笑顔？
lines.english: No thunderbolt? More than that... Huh? Was that... a smile?

lines.japanese: 「ああ玉泉君、ちょうどいいところに。さっき工藤が休むと言っただろう。その代わりとして、今日は鷲介が手伝いに来てくれた」
lines.english: “Ah, Tamaizumi, perfect timing. You remember that Kudou called out earlier. Shuusuke has come to fill in for him today.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そうなんですか？」
lines.english: “What? Really?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、そうなんだ。よろしく頼――」
lines.english: “Y-yeah. That's right. I look forward to wor—”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、助かっちゃいました。手伝いに来てくれて、ありがとうございます千歳さん」
lines.english: “Oh, that's a huge help. Thank you for coming in, Mr. Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 誰っ！？
lines.english: Who are you?!

lines.japanese: 俺は自分の脳内データには存在しない未確認生物を前にして、未知の恐怖にがくがくと足を震わせた。
lines.english: Faced with an unidentified creature absent from every record in my mental database, I shook at the knees in terror of the unknown.

lines.japanese: え、誰このひと？　外見上は俺の知ってる玉泉日和子ってひとだけど、何そのゴキゲンな笑顔、明らかに別人だよね？
lines.english: Who was this person? She looked like the Hiyoko Tamaizumi I knew, but what was with that cheerful smile? This was obviously somebody else.

lines.japanese: そう思い軽部店長に目配せすると、彼は鬱陶しいくらい顔を近づけてきて囁いた。
lines.english: I shot Manager Karube a meaningful glance. He leaned his face oppressively close and whispered.

lines.japanese: 「鷲介……驚いただろう。いや、俺も理由は分からないんだが、今日の玉泉君は出勤してきたときからこの調子なんだ」
lines.english: “Shuusuke... Surprised, aren't you? I don't understand why either, but Tamaizumi has been like this since she arrived today.”

lines.japanese: なんだろう。なんかいいことでもあったのかな。
lines.english: What was going on? Had something good happened to her?

lines.japanese: しかしあの鬼教官も、ああしてニコニコしてる分には普通の女子みたいだ。もともと見てくれは優秀なわけだし、鷲介だったころの俺が舞いあがるの頷ける話──
lines.english: Still, when that demon instructor stood there smiling, she looked almost like an ordinary girl. She had always been easy on the eyes, so I could understand why my former Shuusuke self had gotten carried away—

lines.japanese: ──はっ！　そうか、小鳩以外の選択肢として、玉泉日和子とレンアイするのはどうだろう。
lines.english: —Wait! Of course! As an alternative to Kobato, what if I fell in love with Hiyoko Tamaizumi?

lines.japanese: 「玉泉君、今から俺たちは、女性客の下半身を想像してげへげへする遊びをするんだ」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, Shuusuke and I are about to play a game where we imagine the female customers' lower bodies and snicker lecherously.”

lines.japanese: 「なっ！　ちょ、ちょっとなに言いだすんだこの無精髭！　ちがっ、ちがうぞ玉泉、これは――」
lines.english: “Wha—?! H-hey, what are you saying, you stubbly bastard?! Th-that's not true, Tamaizumi, this is—”
“Manager...”

lines.japanese: ひっ、ひいいぃぃ！　こここ今度こそ雷がァー！
lines.english: E-eek! This time the thunder really was coming!

lines.japanese: 「もうっ、そういう悪ふざけは仕事が終わってからにしてください」
lines.english: “Honestly. Save that kind of horseplay until after work.”

lines.japanese: ええええっ！？
lines.english: Whaaaat?!

lines.japanese: なな、なに、なんなの？　これは何の罰ゲーム？
lines.english: Wh-what? What was going on? Was this some kind of punishment game?

lines.japanese: 未曾有の戦慄が稲妻となって俺の背筋を駆けくだり、俺は思わず腸的な部分を押さえこんだ。
lines.english: A shudder without precedent raced down my spine like lightning, and I reflexively clutched my intestinal region.

lines.japanese: 「それじゃそろそろ仕事を始め……あれ？　千歳さんどうしたんですか？」
lines.english: “Well, we should get to work soon... Oh? What's wrong, Mr. Chitose?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、ちょっとお腹の調子が悪くて」
lines.english: “Oh, um, my stomach's a little upset.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、大丈夫ですか？　薬なら事務室にありますよ」
lines.english: “What? Are you all right? We have medicine in the office.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや平気。その、ちょっとだけ時間をもらえれば……」
lines.english: “N-no, I'm fine. Just give me a minute...”

lines.japanese: うぐぐ、始まる前にいつものリラクゼーションスペースで一呼吸入れよう。この得体のしれない優しさも、慣れない俺にはただの毒だ。
lines.english: Urgh. Before we started, I needed a breather in my customary relaxation space. To a man unaccustomed to it, this mysterious kindness was pure poison.

lines.japanese: そう思ってトイレへ向かいかけた俺に、さらなる追い打ち。
lines.english: I had just started toward the restroom when the next blow landed.

lines.japanese: 「あ、もしかしてお手洗いですか？　分かりました、フォローなら任せてください」
lines.english: “Oh, do you need the restroom? Understood. Leave covering for you to me.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「今日は好きなだけお手洗いに行って構いませんから。くすっ」
lines.english: “You can use the restroom as many times as you like today. Heehee.”

lines.japanese: ひいいいい！
lines.english: Eeeeeek!

lines.japanese: お言葉に甘えて、転がるように駆けこんだ。
lines.english: I gratefully took her at her word and practically rolled into the restroom.

lines.japanese: ななな、何だったんだろう、いまの玉泉日和子は……明らかにおかしかったぞ。
lines.english: Wh-wh-what had come over Hiyoko Tamaizumi...? There was plainly something wrong with her.

lines.japanese: とりあえず結論。彼女と甘い関係を築くには、俺の胃腸を鍛える必要がある。
lines.english: My provisional conclusion: building a sweet relationship with her would require strengthening my digestive tract.

lines.japanese: つまり、やつは無理だ。
lines.english: In other words, she was impossible.

lines.japanese: ちなみに本日の玉泉フィーバーは、打ちあげてすぐに散る花火のようなものではなかった。
lines.english: Incidentally, today's Tamaizumi fever did not vanish like a firework bursting and fading in the same instant.

lines.japanese: 「あー、お腹空いた。今日の昼ごはん、うどんにしちゃったから力出ないよ」
lines.english: “Man, I'm hungry. I only had udon for lunch, so I've got no energy.”

lines.japanese: 「ほほう、ダイエットですか英里子さん。さすがは見栄と執念の女といったところでしょうか」
lines.english: “Oh? Dieting, Eriko? Your vanity and determination never cease to impress.”

lines.japanese: 「違げーよ、ダイエットしてんのは財布の中身だよ。正月に実家帰ったら、親戚の子供がわんさかいてさ。根こそぎお年玉で持ってかれたの」
lines.english: “No, idiot. The only thing on a diet is my wallet. I went home for New Year's and found a whole swarm of relatives' kids. They cleaned me out for New Year's money.”

lines.japanese: 「へえー、英里子さんくらいの年なら、まだもらってる側も多そうなのにねえ」
lines.english: “Really? Plenty of people your age are still on the receiving end.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、学費なんかは親に出してもらってるわけだからね。そんくらいはしなきゃって思って……あー、おなか空いた」
lines.english: “Well, my parents are paying my tuition and everything. I figured I ought to do that much... Man, I'm hungry.”

lines.japanese: 「だったら厨房からこっそりくすねてきたらどうですか。ソーセージとか転がってましたよ」
lines.english: “Then why not sneak something out of the kitchen? I saw some sausages lying around.”

lines.japanese: 「それもいいねー……あでも、さっき厨房の辺りたまひよがうろついてたよ。見つかったらうるさそうじゃん？」
lines.english: “Not a bad idea... Oh, but Tama-chick was prowling around the kitchen earlier. She'd make a fuss if she caught me, right?”

lines.japanese: 「英里子さん」
lines.english: “Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「わあっ！　お、おお、たまひよ。あー、びっくりした。あ、私まだ何も食べてないからね」
lines.english: “Whoa! O-oh, Tama-chick. You scared me. I haven't eaten anything yet, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんの話ですか？　ところで英里子さん、さっき更衣室で着替えてるときにおなか空いたーって言ってましたよね」
lines.english: “What? What are you talking about? Anyway, you said you were hungry while we were changing earlier, didn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　うん、まあね。着替えてるときって言うか、ナウおなか空いてるけど」
lines.english: “Hmm? Yeah. I mean, I wasn't only hungry while we were changing. I'm hungry now.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、そうですよね。ですからさっき厨房へ行く用事があったんですけど──」
lines.english: “Right, I thought so. I had an errand in the kitchen earlier, so—”

lines.japanese: 「──えへへ、こっそりソーセージもらってきちゃいました」
lines.english: “—heehee, I sneaked a sausage out for you.”

lines.japanese: 「も、もらってきちゃいました？」
lines.english: “Y-you did?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ、たまひよが？　ま、まあそりゃー、くれるならありがたくもらうけどさ」
lines.english: “Wait, you, Tama-chick? W-well, if you're offering, I'm not gonna turn it down.”

lines.japanese: いったい何事だ。規律を重んじ不正を憎む、あの正義の玉泉教官が。
lines.english: What in the world was happening? This was the righteous Instructor Tamaizumi, who revered discipline and despised dishonesty.

lines.japanese: 「それとせっかくなんで、パンとレタスとケチャップとマスタードも一緒にもらってきました」
lines.english: “And since I was there, I also brought bread, lettuce, ketchup, and mustard.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなに！？　え、ちょっともらいすぎだろ」
lines.english: “That much?! Hey, isn't that overdoing it?”

lines.japanese: 「ていうかホットドッグが出来るじゃん！」
lines.english: “Wait, that's a whole hot dog!”

lines.japanese: 「店長に見つからないように、こっそり食べてくださいね。あ、もちろん内緒ですよ」
lines.english: “Eat it somewhere the manager won't see. And of course, this stays between us.”

lines.japanese: 「な、何だったんだ今のは……まるで別人みたいでしたね、英里子さん」
lines.english: “Wh-what was that...? It was like she'd become a completely different person, Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……まあ、いやむしろ、今のほうがたまひよって感じかも……」
lines.english: “Yeah... Though honestly, that felt more like the real Tama-chick...”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「え、何それ？　だって玉泉と言えば、いつも見えない敵を憎んでるひとじゃないですか」
lines.english: “What do you mean? Tamaizumi is the woman who's always furious at enemies nobody else can see.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、んなことないよ。今のがたまひよだよ。昔はあんな風に私に懐いててさー」
lines.english: “No, she's not. What you just saw is Tama-chick. She used to follow me around like that all the time.”

lines.japanese: 「そういやたまひよがお客さんのケーキ羨ましそうに見てるから、私が厨房から同じケーキくすねてきてさ。二人で見つかって、珍しく店長に怒られたなー」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, once Tama-chick was staring enviously at a customer's cake, so I swiped one just like it from the kitchen. We both got caught, and for once the manager really chewed us out.”

lines.japanese: 「そのときもたまひよは私に文句言わないで、ありがとうございますって言って、今度は見つからないようにしましょーなんつって、だから私もつい甘やかしちゃってさー。うんうん、そんな頃もあったよ」
lines.english: “Even then, Tama-chick didn't complain. She thanked me and said we'd have to make sure nobody caught us next time. So of course I spoiled her. Yeah, yeah. Those were the days.”

lines.japanese: 「回想シーン入ってるところ申し訳ないんですけど、あのちょっと英里子さん、語りすぎであなたキモいです」
lines.english: “Sorry to interrupt your flashback, but you're oversharing, Eriko, and it's creepy.”

lines.japanese: 「おーい、たまひよー。今日いっしょに休憩入るぞー」
lines.english: “Heeey, Tama-chick. We're taking our break together today.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いいんですか英里子さん。はい、一緒にお茶しましょう」
lines.english: “What? We are? Yes, let's have tea together.”

lines.japanese: うーむ、本当に何があったんだろう……。
lines.english: Hmm. What in the world had happened...?

lines.japanese: だが日野英里子は納得してる風だった。むしろ嬉しそうに見えた。
lines.english: But Eriko Hino seemed satisfied. If anything, she looked happy.

lines.japanese: もしや、俺が玉泉日和子という人物を理解していなかっただけなのだろうか。
lines.english: Could it be that I had simply failed to understand the person Hiyoko Tamaizumi was?

lines.japanese: 元来あの鬼教官も、ちょっと嬉しいことがあれば機嫌がよくなる、普通の女子だったのだろうか。
lines.english: Perhaps the demon instructor had always been an ordinary girl whose mood brightened whenever something nice happened.

lines.japanese: ふうむ、たった一ヵ月の付き合い程度じゃ分からないことだらけだ。人間とは奥が深い。
lines.english: Hmm. A single month together still left so much unknown. Human beings were deep creatures indeed.

lines.japanese: で、日野英里子がホットドッグ食べている間、上司の注意を引きつけてあげることにした。
lines.english: While Eriko Hino ate her hot dog, I decided to distract our superior.

lines.japanese: 「ときに軽部店長、新年からずっと気になっていたことがあるのですが」
lines.english: “By the way, Manager Karube, there's something that's bothered me since New Year's.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、俺のマグナムか？　おそらくおまえの想像通りだ。なかなかデカい」
lines.english: “Hmm? My magnum? It is probably just as you imagine. Quite enormous.”

lines.japanese: 「ええまあ、そんな単発銃のニューナンブはいいんですけど、それよりこの店内ヤバくないですか」
lines.english: “Yes, well, never mind that little peashooter. Isn't something seriously wrong with this dining room?”

lines.japanese: 「なに、ヤバいくらい店長がカッコイイだと」
lines.english: “What? You mean the manager is dangerously handsome?”

lines.japanese: 「モールくらいなら笑って流してくれるひともいるでしょうけど、ツリーはヤバくないですか。もう角松の時期も通りこして、次は桜の準備ですよ」
lines.english: “Some people might laugh off a few garlands, but isn't the tree going too far? We've passed the season for New Year's decorations, and next up is cherry blossoms.”

lines.japanese: 入口に堂々と置かれたクリスマスツリー。本部にばれたら怒られそうなディスプレイを指差して、俺は親切心から教えてあげた。
lines.english: I pointed out the Christmas tree standing proudly at the entrance, a display that would surely earn him a scolding if head office learned of it.

lines.japanese: 「ときに鷲介、おまえ去年のクリスマスはどう過ごした」
lines.english: “By the way, Shuusuke. How did you spend Christmas last year?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？　あ、いや、家族と過ごしましたけど……二人きりで」
lines.english: “What? Oh, with family... just the two of us.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか……実は俺もせっかくのクリスマスなので、たまたま知人の紹介で知りあった２７歳ＯＬを閉店後に招待したんだ」
lines.english: “I see... As it was Christmas, I invited a twenty-seven-year-old office worker I happened to meet through an acquaintance to join me after closing.”

lines.japanese: 「ところがここから大変なことが起こった。聞いてくれ、彼女はいくらかけても電話に出ず、メールを送っても返事がないんだ。これは事故に遭ったとしか考えられないじゃないか」
lines.english: “Then disaster struck. Listen to this: no matter how often I called, she did not answer. I emailed, and she did not reply. Clearly, she must have been in an accident.”

lines.japanese: 「だが俺は思うんだ。彼女はきっと病院のベッドで、俺と過ごすクリスマスを楽しみにしている……ああそうさ、その日を楽しみに今も頑張っているに違いないんだ。それだけを楽しみに生きているんだ」
lines.english: “But here is what I think: lying in her hospital bed, she surely longs for the Christmas she was to spend with me... Yes. The promise of that day must sustain her even now. It is the sole pleasure for which she lives.”

lines.japanese: 「だからな？　鷲介……俺は自分から誘った以上、彼女が退院する日まで待っていてやりたいんだ。だってそうだろう？　彼女のクリスマスはまだ終わっちゃいないんだぜ」
lines.english: “And so, Shuusuke... Since I invited her, I intend to wait until the day she leaves the hospital. It is only right. Her Christmas has not ended yet.”

lines.japanese: 「いや止めを刺すようで申し訳ないけど、それ単に他に予定があって、来なかっただけだよね？」
lines.english: “Sorry to deliver the killing blow, but she just had other plans and stood you up, right?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだとテメエ！　苦しんでる彼女を馬鹿にしたらただじゃおかねえぞ！　彼女のために……いや俺たちのために、俺はこのクリスマスディスプレイを絶対に片付けないぞ」
lines.english: “What did you say, you bastard?! Mock that suffering woman and you will answer to me! For her sake... no, for our sake, I will never take down these Christmas decorations!”

lines.japanese: 「俺のクリスマスはまだ終わってないんだ！」
lines.english: “My Christmas isn't over yet!”

lines.japanese: 最後の方は嗚咽するような声で、軽部店長は力強く演説した。
lines.english: Manager Karube delivered the end of this forceful speech in a voice choked with sobs.

lines.japanese: ああコレ、本部にバレて怒られるまでは、断じて片付けないつもりだろうな。
lines.english: Yeah, he had no intention whatsoever of taking them down until head office caught him and raised hell.

lines.japanese: しかしこのひとは、どこまで本気か分からない。馬鹿な言動は単なるポーズで、本当はかなりのキレ者と思わせることも多いし。
lines.english: Then again, I could never tell how serious this man was. He often made me suspect the idiocy was only an act and that he was actually pretty sharp.

lines.japanese: いつも中学生みたいな下ネタばっかり言ってるけど、実際は大人の恋愛をいくつも重ねて──
lines.english: He never stopped making jokes fit for a middle-school boy, but perhaps in reality he had lived through one adult romance after another—

lines.japanese: ──ああ、そうか。
lines.english: —Oh, of course.

lines.japanese: 「店長なら数をこなしてそうですね」
lines.english: “You've probably been around the block plenty of times, Manager.”

lines.japanese: 「んっ？　なんの話だ。もしかして、深夜番組を見ていたら思わぬ拾いものを見つけてしまった夜の過ごし方についての話か」
lines.english: “Hmm? What are we discussing? How one spends a night when late-night television unexpectedly delivers buried treasure?”

lines.japanese: 「いやさっきの話の続きです。恋愛です。店長にも純粋に恋愛してた時代だってあるでしょう」
lines.english: “No, I'm continuing our conversation. About romance. You must have had a time when you loved someone innocently.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうむ、純粋に……何を持って純粋とするか難しいところだが、思いだすのには時間がかかるな」
lines.english: “Hmm. Innocently... A difficult quality to define. Either way, recalling it will take some time.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな記憶を辿らないと思いだせないくらい昔なんですか」
lines.english: “It was so long ago you have to dig through your memories?”

lines.japanese: 「いや前世」
lines.english: “No. It was in a previous life.”

lines.japanese: 「生まれたときから成長してないわけですか」
lines.english: “So you haven't matured since the day you were born.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ、ある一面で言えば正しくそうだな。男は生まれた時から恋愛してるのさ」
lines.english: “Hmm. From one perspective, that is precisely correct. A man is in love from the moment he is born.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、これじゃ参考にならないなあ……」
lines.english: “Sigh. You're no use at all...”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ。俺で駄目なら、あそこの二人にでも聞いてみたらどうだ」
lines.english: “Hmm. If I won't do, why not ask those two?”

lines.japanese: 「二人？」
lines.english: “Those two?”

lines.japanese: 軽部店長が顎で示した方向へ首を合わせると、そこには二人の男女が楽しそうに会話していた。
lines.english: I followed the direction of Manager Karube's nod and saw a man and woman chatting happily.

lines.japanese: ふむ。鳳翔と望月紀奈子か。
lines.english: Hmm. Kakeru Ohtori and Kinako Mochizuki.

lines.japanese: あの二人はよくぶつかり合っているが、なんだかんだ一緒にいるところを見ると、本当は仲が良いのだろうか。
lines.english: The two of them clashed often, but given how frequently I saw them together anyway, perhaps they were friends after all.

lines.japanese: 「でー？　浪人、今週末に試験あるんでしょ。調子どーなの」
lines.english: “So, Retaker? You've got an exam this weekend, right? How's it looking?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、心配してくれてるんだ？　鳳君やさしいね」
lines.english: “Oh, you're worried about me? That's sweet of you, Ohtori.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、まァねー」
lines.english: “Yeah, well.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、やっべー、手ぇ滑ってコップ落としちゃった。ごめんマスター、弁償すっから新しいコップ持ってきてくんない？　あっやべ、また落としちゃった。いやー、今日はよく手が滑る日だわー」
lines.english: “Whoops. My hand slipped and I dropped my glass. Sorry, Boss. I'll pay for it, so could you bring me another? Whoops, dropped that one too. Man, my hands sure are slippery today.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳君、意外とうっかり屋さんなんだね。駄目だよしっかりしなくちゃ。私みたいにね」
lines.english: “You're surprisingly clumsy, Ohtori. You need to be more careful. Like me.”

lines.japanese: 「あっはっは、落ちる落ちる、滑る滑るー。やっべコレ止まんねえわー」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Falling, failing, slipping, sliding. Whoops, I can't stop.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、ホウキ。鳳君、ちゃんと自分で掃除してね」
lines.english: “Here's a broom. Clean it up yourself, Ohtori.”

lines.japanese: うーむ……仲悪そうにも良さそうにも、どちらにも見えるな。
lines.english: Hmm... They looked equally capable of being friends or enemies.

lines.japanese: 「二人ともいらっしゃい。なんか楽しそうな話してるみたいじゃん、混ぜて混ぜて」
lines.english: “Hey, you two. Sounds like you're having fun. Let me in on it.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、シュウちゃん。楽しそうっつーかネタがないから浪人イジって遊んでただけ」
lines.english: “Oh, Shuu. Not exactly fun. I ran out of material, so I was passing the time by messing with Retaker.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君は最近、面白いことあった？」
lines.english: “Anything interesting happen to you lately, Chitose?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、俺？　まあ楽しいっていうか、二人の恋愛遍歴とか？」
lines.english: “Me? Well, speaking of fun... How about your romantic histories?”

lines.japanese: 「え、恋バナ？　どしたの急に。好きなひとでも出来たの？」
lines.english: “What, love talk? Where'd that come from? Find somebody you like?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、急ってわけでもないんですけど、ちょっと若者らしい会話でもしようかなと思って」
lines.english: “Not exactly out of nowhere. I thought I'd try having a conversation fit for a young person.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳君は？」
lines.english: “What about you, Ohtori?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、俺？　ネタにできるような話ないんだよね。笑えないのが多くて」
lines.english: “Me? Nothing I could turn into a funny story. Most of mine aren't funny.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、なるほどねえ。紀奈子さんは？」
lines.english: “I see. That makes sense. What about you, Kinako?”

lines.japanese: 「私もネタになるような話ないんだよね」
lines.english: “I don't have any stories worth telling either.”

lines.japanese: 「ネタになるどころか、恋愛自体に縁がないもんねえ」
lines.english: “You don't have any romance at all, never mind a story.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君は？」
lines.english: “What about you, Chitose?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、恋愛っていうか、色々悩んだりはしますね。例えば環境とか立場とか」
lines.english: “Well, I wouldn't call it romance, but I worry about things. Circumstances and positions, for instance.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、分かる分かる」
lines.english: “Oh, I know exactly what you mean.”

lines.japanese: 「いや相手いないんだから分かんないでしょ」
lines.english: “You don't have anyone, so no, you don't.”

lines.japanese: 「私も受験生じゃなかったらね」
lines.english: “If I weren't studying for entrance exams...”

lines.japanese: 「ははあ、紀奈子さんも受験生じゃなかったら恋の一つもすると」
lines.english: “Ah, so if you weren’t studying for entrance exams, you’d find a little romance, Kinako?”

lines.japanese: 「いっぺんに何かしようとしても、どっちつかずになっちゃうからね。目の前のこと一つ一つ片付けていくことが大切だよ」
lines.english: “If you try to do everything at once, you'll end up accomplishing neither. It's important to deal with the things in front of you one by one.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ、年の功ってやつか。紀奈子さんのひとはいいこと言うなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. The wisdom of age. That Kinako person says such insightful things.”

lines.japanese: 「誉めるのかイジるのかどっちかにしろよ」
lines.english: “Either compliment me or make fun of me. Pick one.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど、為になりました。ありがとうございます紀奈子さん」
lines.english: “I see. That was educational. Thank you, Kinako.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな大したこと言ってないけどね。うん、頑張って」
lines.english: “I didn't say anything that profound. But sure. Do your best.”

lines.japanese: 「で、為になること言ってる浪人は誰かと付きあったことあんの」
lines.english: “So, has our educational Retaker ever gone out with anyone?”

lines.japanese: 「ううんないよ」
lines.english: “Nope.”

lines.japanese: 「ないのかよ！」
lines.english: “You haven't?!”

lines.japanese: 「今の話はうにうにがテレビで言ってたんだよ」
lines.english: “I heard Uni-Uni say that on TV.”

lines.japanese: 「テレビかよ！」
lines.english: “It was from TV?!”

lines.japanese: 駄目だこのひと。頼りになるどころか、信頼度ゼロだ。
lines.english: This woman was hopeless. She wasn't dependable; her credibility was zero.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに恋バナ？　混ぜて混ぜて」
lines.english: “What, love talk? Let me in, let me in.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、えりちゃんだー。うん、千歳君が恋に悩んでるらしいよ」
lines.english: “Oh, Eri! Sure. Apparently Chitose is troubled by love.”

lines.japanese: 「なーんだ千歳かあ」
lines.english: “Oh. It's just Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なにその反応……なんか冷たくないですか」
lines.english: “What kind of reaction is that...? Isn't that a little cold?”

lines.japanese: 「だあってえ、千歳前に言ってたじゃん。おまえ雷鳴ってたら泣くような女がいいんだろ？」
lines.english: “Becaaause, Chitose, you said it before. You want a girl who cries when she hears thunder, right?”

lines.japanese: 「いわゆるアレだ？　清純系だ。純粋な心の持ち主がいいってやつでしょ」
lines.english: “You know, that whole pure maiden thing. You want somebody with an innocent heart.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、年下の子とかそういうの？」
lines.english: “Oh, like a younger girl?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ひとの好みを特殊みたいに言わないでください。俺、シスコンとかロリコンとかそういうのないですから」
lines.english: “Don't make my preferences sound like a fetish. I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything.”

lines.japanese: 「うぇ、シスコンとかキメぇ」
lines.english: “Ew. Siscons are gross.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、妹にべったりーなんて男のひとはちょっと引いちゃうよね」
lines.english: “Yeah. A man who's all over his little sister is kind of a turnoff.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ、黙れよ、死ねよ腐れヌンコ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Drop dead, you rotten nunt.”

lines.japanese: 「まったくだよ、黙れよ、死ねよ腐れヌンコ」
lines.english: “Seriously. Shut up and die, you rotten nunt.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでこの二人、急に息合わせてんの？」
lines.english: “Why are those two suddenly in perfect sync?”

lines.japanese: 「二人ともシスコンなんじゃない？」
lines.english: “Maybe they're both siscons.”

lines.japanese: 結局、今日は一日、役に立ちそうな結果を得られなかった。明日にもりもり期待しよう。
lines.english: In the end, I got no useful results all day. I would heap all my hopes on tomorrow.
